verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents official MCP servers ('Airbyte Agents') that let MCP-capable agents like Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, and Codex connect to Airbyte-managed data, with dedicated docs and a probe confirming the page exists. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server actually working in practice, and more detail on setup/configuration depth.
